maxillary_keypoint_topology.keypoint_spatial_matrix: The uppermost keypoints are positioned approximately 1.5 spot-diameters superior to the secondary dense row, following a curvilinear trajectory consistent with the lateral maxillary curvature.

rhinarium_pixel_ratio.melanin_saturation_percentage: Approximately 75% melanin saturation, with dense dark pigmentation concentrated at the nares and philtrum, and a lighter depigmented pinkish-brown region on the central rhinarium apex.
